rapport_notes: Professional and informative but the price-objection moment was handled generically rather than with real curiosity.

evidence_quotes.agenda: Not asked; this call picks up after a walkthrough already happened elsewhere, delivering the priced quote.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer said 'the cost is a little on the high side... not sure I'm ready to commit' — rep replied with a generic reassurance (no deposit, direct employees) and pivoted, without asking what she was comparing against.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: None of the five lines used at the moment of price hesitation, which is exactly where they matter most.

top_strength: Gave a very clearly personalized estimate breakdown (4 movers, 2 trucks, box-count math) that answered her follow-up questions confidently.
coaching_note: This was a live price objection — this is exactly the moment for the Save Your Ass lines (commit-to-rate, 'the estimate is a window,' self-prep tip) instead of a generic reassurance.
